About me

A little about who I am and what drives me.

Namaskara! 🙏

I’m Pavan, a BCA student who can’t resist taking things apart to see how they work. Technology isn’t just my course; it’s the thing I read about, tinker with and build with, long after class ends.

I learn by making: small projects first, then bigger ones, each teaching me something the textbooks couldn’t. Along the way I’ve collected projects and achievements I’m proud of, and I’m still hungry for the next challenge.

Curious, consistent and always up for learning something new. Let’s build something great.

Projects

Things I’ve built.

CivicEye

CivicEye: Smart Public Issue Reporting

My BCA final year project. Citizens report garbage, potholes, drainage, streetlight and water leakage issues with a photo, GPS location, category and date. An admin dashboard routes each complaint to the right department, tracks its status (Pending, In Progress, Resolved) and notifies the citizen. Location-based reporting cuts duplicate complaints, and analytics reports show recurring problem zones. AI image classification is planned.
